description: Header file defining RAII classes and helper functions for saving and restoring stream states (iostream flags, precision, etc.) in the Abseil C++ library, specifically within the random internal namespace.

classes.name: null_state_saver
classes.description: A no-op RAII class that does nothing when saving/restoring stream state.

classes.name: ostream_state_saver
classes.description: RAII class that saves and restores the state of an output stream.

classes.name: istream_state_saver
classes.description: RAII class that saves and restores the state of an input stream.

methods.name: make_ostream_state_saver
methods.description: Factory function to create an ostream_state_saver with default flags.

methods.name: make_istream_state_saver
methods.description: Factory function to create an istream_state_saver with default flags.

methods.name: stream_precision_helper
methods.description: Template struct providing the required precision for streaming floating point types.

methods.name: stream_format_type
methods.description: Helper struct to convert certain types for stream output.

methods.name: stream_u128_helper
methods.description: Helper struct for reading and writing 128-bit unsigned integers.

methods.name: read_floating_point
methods.description: Function to read floating point values robustly from a stream.
